lines.zh: 我走路的姿势，和你一样。
lines.en: I walk the way you do.
I step on the pebbles you stepped on.

lines.zh: 你的肩膀怎么摆，我也怎么摆。
lines.en: Whatever your shoulders do, mine do too.
I keep half a step behind, always following.
I just walked this road once already.
The door ahead. I'll open it.

lines.zh: 我的脚步和你的完全一样。
lines.en: My footfalls match yours exactly.
You walk faster, so do I.
My steps fall exactly with yours.
You look back, and I slow down.
I copy you well, don't I?

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边，是我的影子。
lines.en: Beside your shadow is mine.
I stand, copying your stance.

lines.zh: 你手放哪儿，我手放哪儿。
lines.en: Where your hands go, mine go.
I'm waiting for you to move first.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸跟着你的节奏。
lines.en: My breathing keeps your rhythm.
You look up, and so do I.
You like this quiet too, don't you?
I'm memorizing your little habits.
You scratched your neck.
I scratched mine too.
You smiled? I'm not good at that.
Does this face look familiar?
That face is yours.
Don't touch your own face. It won't help.
You can't tell us apart now, can you.
I look more like you than you do.
You step back, and so do I.
Your wooden door comes apart in my hands.
Which of us was here first?
I speak before you do.

lines.zh: 你叫什么名字？我不记得了。
lines.en: What's your name? I've forgotten.
You're hitting your own face.

lines.zh: 我退后的样子，和你一样。
lines.en: I back away just like you.
This face is torn. I can get another.
You hit as hard as I do.

lines.zh: 这一下的角度，我照着学。
lines.en: I learn that angle exactly.
We even hurt the same way.

lines.zh: 我的表情终于有点变化。
lines.en: My expression finally changed a little.
Not the face. I haven't finished learning it.
Your hand shook, and so did mine.
I'll keep this one.

lines.zh: 你伸手拿东西，我也伸手。
lines.en: You reach for it, and so do I.
Your share is mine.

lines.zh: 你吃东西的样子，我记住了。
lines.en: I've memorized how you eat.
Don't bite yet. Let me watch first.
I want the half you saved.
I copy you and lift the food.
You swallow, and so do I.
Did you taste this?
You're distracted. Perfect.
Your hand shook once.
You hit me like hitting a mirror.
I step back exactly as far as you.
We both raise a hand at once.
Your movement was copied once.
Don't push. We weigh the same.
I walk shoulder to shoulder with you.

lines.zh: 你的脚印我只能踩一半。
lines.en: I can only take half of your footprints.
I bump you, then pull away.
You look at me, I look at you.
Can't tell who moved first.
I'll copy that.
But I don't need it.
I only need one face.
Yours will do nicely.
Don't be shy. I'm not really anyone.
Put your hands down.
I only imitate. I don't respond.
Your expression changed.
Mine changed too.
Let it be.
You bend down, and so do I.
I touched it first.
You have two of these, don't you.
I'll take one. The rest is yours.
You pick it up, and I put mine down.
We really are identical.
You bend to pick it up, so do I.

lines.zh: 我把它藏进袖子里，连同你的脸。
lines.en: I tuck it in my sleeve, along with your face.
You can't see where I hid it.
I'm a good mimic, aren't I?
I'll take that face.
I remember where you stand.
I'm coming over.

lines.zh: 你别跑，跑起来就不像了。
lines.en: Don't run. You stop looking like yourself.
My pace is picking up.

lines.zh: 你转身的方向，我算到了。
lines.en: I calculated which way you'd turn.
I chase at your speed.
You turn, and I'm there.
You raised a hand, and so did I.
I'll take that face.
Your breathing broke, and so did mine.
Let's begin, your way.
I copy your opening stance.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸乱了，我已经贴上来。
lines.en: Your breathing broke; I'm already on you.

lines.zh: 我不用看，也知道你往哪走。
lines.en: I don't need to look to know where you'll go.
Your posture is the answer.
I can count which foot you lead with.
I copy your stance, half a beat late.

lines.zh: 你的影子后面，多了一道影子。
lines.en: Behind your shadow, another shadow.
I follow, not one step off.
Look back and you'll see yourself.
When you lift a foot, I lift mine.
I can open this door.
Locking it won't help.
I have already torn the wooden door open.
Your hands are feeling along the wall.
I reach out too.
I push the wooden door ajar.

lines.zh: 我照着你的脸，换了五官。
lines.en: I rearrange my features to match your face.
I know this route better than you do.
You raise a hand. I'm there first.
Your shadow paused for a moment.
Mine paused too.
How many times have you looked back?
This time I'm in front of you.
You and I have gone the same circle.
This blow is your own move.
I strike the way you strike.
You've been hit by yourself.
My strength matches yours.
I learned your guard too.
Does this punch look familiar?
You stepped back, so did I.
You raise your weapon. I'm empty-handed.
I still hit you.
I have blood too.
I just learned this kick from you.
I hit you with your own strength.
I remember the order of your moves.
I raised my hand before you did.
The second strike comes from behind.
The second was prepared for you.

lines.zh: 你踉跄的样子，我演得像。
lines.en: I play the stumble convincingly.
My hand is on your shoulder; do not struggle.
Your weapon slipped from your hand.

lines.zh: 我照着你的角度补一拳。
lines.en: I add a punch at your own angle.

lines.zh: 你从这边过来，我也从这边来。
lines.en: You came this way, so did I.
We passed each other.
You glanced back at me.

lines.zh: 那一瞬间，我记住了你的脸。
lines.en: In that instant, I memorized your face.
Now I have it too.
We walk the same road.
There are two sets of your footsteps.
There's one more shadow in the wind.
Let me borrow your face a while.
Let me see clearly.
I'll borrow your eyes.

lines.zh: 我站在你刚站过的地方。
lines.en: I stand where you just stood.

lines.zh: 火苗舔上来，这层皮卷了。
lines.en: Flames licked up and this skin curled.

lines.zh: 摔下去的姿势，我学得很快。
lines.en: I learn the falling posture quickly.
My face loses shape in the water.

lines.zh: 冲击把我的轮廓掀歪了。
lines.en: The blast knocked my outline crooked.

lines.zh: 一支箭穿过来，穿的是你的脸。
lines.en: An arrow came through your face.

lines.zh: 咒语照过来，我被看穿了。
lines.en: The spell shone on me and saw right through me.

lines.zh: 饿着的时候，模仿会走样。
lines.en: Hunger makes my mimicry slip.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我的脸白了一下。
lines.en: The lightning flash turned my face white.

lines.zh: 这里没有可以照的东西。
lines.en: There's nothing here to reflect.
